html:
The Binbinga, also spelled Binbinka, are an Aboriginal Australian people of the Gulf country of the Northern Territory, in the McArthur River area inland from Borroloola.

Their language belongs to the small West Barkly group with that of the Wambaya and the Gudanji. Other neighbours were the Yanyuwa on the coast and islands, and the Garrwa and Gunindiri.

Cattle stations reached the Gulf country in the 1880s, and the language is no longer spoken. A large zinc and lead mine opened on the McArthur River in the 1990s.
sum: The Binbinga, also spelled Binbinka, are an Aboriginal Australian people of the Gulf country of the Northern Territory, in the McArthur River area inland from Borroloola.
